biggest_catch: Concrete payout mechanism, no concrete payout timing: official Rebag pages never state how long wallet funds take to reach your bank.
catches: Official pages confirm instant offers (or email quote within two business days) and Rebag Wallet funds, but no official page states a concrete payout-to-bank timing.
The 3% cash-out fee applies to withdrawals within 15 days, but the wallet-to-bank transfer duration is not published on official pages.
